author: Romann1236
quote: I have played the game on ps5 pro, 13 years of waiting… for WHAT?? 30 fps… sometimes 20 fps if you do something a little too crazy for the game…. Some games on Xbox or Nintendo work fine at 60 fps with as good or even better graphics. Yes the game is big and has full servers but honestly, your fault rockstar… you should have planned better for a game with this much hype. And the glitches? Yes it is the first week of release but still, this feels like cyberpunk all over again… the game also feels repetitive and slow, with long missions that lack action. It feels like the game is trying to act « deep » with it’s couple story but it really isn’t, it just feels like a couple simulator… not a good game on my side!
